description: This is a PHP source file defining a REST API endpoint for validation of unique entity attributes within the OrangeHRM system. It provides an API class 'ValidationUniqueAPI' that handles GET requests to verify if a certain value for a specified entity attribute is unique, along with validation rules and external DAO interactions.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for checking the uniqueness of specific attribute values of various entities within OrangeHRM. Implements validation rules and handles the GET request to validate entity attribute uniqueness.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to determine if a provided value for a specific entity attribute is unique. Uses DAO to check database and returns the result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for incoming GET request parameters, ensuring correct input lengths and acceptable values.

methods.name: getAttributeNameRuleArray
methods.description: Retrieves allowed attribute names for the specified entity to validate input.

methods.name: getMatchByFieldRuleArray
methods.description: Retrieves allowed 'matchByField' options for the specified entity.

methods.name: getValidationUniqueDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the DAO object responsible for database validation queries.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method not implemented, intended for updating resources.

methods.description: Method not implemented, validation rules for update operation.

methods.description: Method not implemented, validation rules for delete operation.
